cacheCondition: Fresh isolated context each trial; host and external APIs real; local repository scripts intercepted before navigation; 24 synthetic TV Favorite identities; OS/network cache not cold.

callbackDiagnostic.method: ContentRows callback functions wrapped before native ContentRows.call, then per-callback invocation durations recorded; one isolated run per revision, supplementary only and excluded from the paired 10-run benchmark.
callbackDiagnostic.caveat: One sample each; callback invocation count depends on asynchronous provider registration. Not evidence of a startup optimization.

pairedDifferences.method: branch minus main within each of 10 alternating pairs; approximate 95% t interval (df=9)

status: No statistically persuasive/meaningful startup improvement; leave PR Draft.

productionChange.behavior: scheduleRefreshMarks measures card rectangles once and queues refresh only for cards intersecting the viewport; previously deferred offscreen cards recompute marks/notch on native hover:focus before interaction.
productionChange.test: tests/ydesign.cjs: 25-row/150-card fixture refreshes only 12 visible cards; focus hook refreshes deferred offscreen card state.
productionChange.performanceVerdict: No measurable first-startup/first-usable-Home gain in 10 matched pairs. Change reduces redundant work after a mark-refresh event and remains a scoped runtime optimization, not a claimed startup speedup.

measuredConclusion: Native Lampa app.min.js frameVisible/frameUpdate plus DOM append activity are the strongest recurring sampled render costs. appready-to-first-card median was about 0.72–0.76 s. The repo-side YDesign refresh change is not the first-card/focus critical path; paired first-usable timing confidence interval crosses zero. No meaningful startup improvement established; PR must remain Draft.
